teaser.en: An unidentified mushroom whose name shares a root with the Digo word for something slippery.
teaser.sw: Uyoga ambao haujatambuliwa, wenye jina linaloshiriki mzizi na neno la Kidigo la kitu kinachoteleza.
teaser.dg: Uoga ambao taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi, na dzinare rina asili mwenga na neno ra Chidigo ra chitu chenye uhereza.

summary.en: Nlikosi is a mushroom known to Digo collectors that has not yet been scientifically identified. Pakia records only its name.
summary.sw: Nlikosi ni uyoga unaojulikana na wakusanyaji wa Kidigo ambao bado haujatambuliwa kisayansi. Pakia anarekodi jina lake tu.
summary.dg: *Nlikosi* ni uoga unaomanyikana ni Adigo anaotsola uoga, ela taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi. Pakia anaandika dzinare tu.

about.en: *Nlikosi* is a mushroom that Digo collectors know by name but that has not yet been scientifically identified. Pakia notes that some of the mushrooms he collected were still awaiting identification when his study was written. Digo collectors tell mushrooms apart mainly by the colour of the cap, but no description of *nlikosi* is recorded.
about.sw: *nlikosi* ni uyoga ambao wakusanyaji wa Kidigo wanaujua kwa jina lakini bado haujatambuliwa kisayansi. Pakia anaeleza kuwa baadhi ya uyoga aliokusanya ulikuwa bado unasubiri kutambuliwa wakati utafiti wake ulipoandikwa. Wakusanyaji wa Kidigo hutofautisha uyoga hasa kwa rangi ya kofia, lakini hakuna maelezo ya *nlikosi* yaliyorekodiwa.
about.dg: *Nlikosi* ni uoga ambao Adigo anaotsola uoga anaumanya kpwa dzina, ela taudzangbwemanyikana kpwa chisayansi. Pakia anaandika kukala wakati achiandika kaziye, aina zanjina za uoga arizozitsola kala bado tazidzangbwemanyikana. Adigo anaotsola uoga anatafwautisha aina za uoga hasa kpwa rangi ya kofiya, ela takuna chitu chirichoandikpwa cha vira *nlikosi* unavyoonekana.

where.en: Digo mushroom collectors recognise three mushroom grounds: *Brachystegia* woodland (*mirihini*), farmland (*mdani*) and termite mounds (*tsuluni*). Which of these this mushroom favours is not recorded.
where.sw: Wakusanyaji wa uyoga wa Kidigo wanatambua maeneo matatu ya uyoga: msitu wa *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), mashamba (*mdani*) na vichuguu (*tsuluni*). Haijarekodiwa ni lipi kati ya haya ambalo uyoga huu hupendelea.
where.dg: Adigo anaotsola uoga anamanya aina hahu za phatu ambapho uoga unamera: phatu phenye mirihi, *Brachystegia* (*mirihini*), minda (*mdani*) na tsulu (*tsuluni*). Ela takuna chitu chirichoandikpwa cha kuonyesa kukala uoga huno unamendza zaidi kumera kuphi kahi ya aina hizo hahu.

uses.en: Pakia notes that the Digo give names only to mushrooms they know as edible, so *nlikosi* is very likely one that local people collect and eat. Wild mushrooms should only be eaten when identified by someone with expert local knowledge.
uses.sw: Pakia anaeleza kuwa Wadigo huipa majina uyoga tu wanaoujua kuwa unalika, kwa hiyo huenda sana *nlikosi* ni mmoja wa uyoga ambao wenyeji hukusanya na kula. Uyoga wa porini unapaswa kuliwa tu ukiwa umetambuliwa na mtu mwenye ujuzi wa kina wa kienyeji.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anazipha madzina aina za uoga ambazo anazimanya kukala zinariwa tu, kpwa hivyo kuna dalili nyinji kukala *nlikosi* ni uoga ambao atu a phapha anautsola na kuurya. Uoga wa weruni taufwaha kuriwa hadi umanyikane ni mutu mwenye ujuzi mkulu wa uoga wa phapha.

culture.en: Mushroom collecting is women's work among the Digo. Pakia found that only about ten kinds, those learnt from the elders as edible, are eaten, and that collectors pick them young, with the cap still closed (*fundula*), because open caps (*bumula*) are usually full of worms.
culture.sw: Kukusanya uyoga ni kazi ya wanawake miongoni mwa Wadigo. Pakia aligundua kuwa ni aina takriban kumi tu zinazoliwa, zile ambazo wazee walifundisha kuwa zinalika, na kwamba wakusanyaji huzichuma zikiwa changa, kofia ikiwa bado imefunga (*fundula*), kwa sababu kofia zilizofunguka (*bumula*) kwa kawaida hujaa funza.
culture.dg: Kahi ya Adigo, kutsola uoga ni kazi ya achetu. Pakia waona kukala ni aina kama kumi tu za uoga zinazoriwa, zira ambazo anaotsola akadzifundza kula kpwa azehe kukala zinariwa, na kukala anautsola uoga uchere mdide, kofiyaye ichikala bado taidzangbwevuguka (*fundula*), kpwa sababu kofiya ichivuguka (*bumula*), mara nyinji uoga unakala na mabulu manji.

names.en: Pakia records *nlikosi*; its meaning is not explained. Elsewhere Pakia gives *likosi* as the Digo word for algae, and the Mgombato dictionary gives it as 'something slippery, a slippery place'. Whether the mushroom is named for a slippery cap is not recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *nlikosi*; maana yake haielezwi. Mahali pengine Pakia anatoa *likosi* kama neno la Kidigo la mwani, na kamusi ya Mgombato inalieleza kuwa 'kitu kinachoteleza, mahali panapoteleza'. Haijarekodiwa kama uyoga huu umepewa jina kwa sababu ya kofia inayoteleza.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *nlikosi*; manaye taielezwa. Phatu phanjina Pakia anaandika *likosi* kukala ni neno ra Chidigo ra *algae*, na kamusi ya Mgombato inalavya kukala ni chitu chenye uhereza, au phatu phenye uhereza. Ela taiandikpwa kukala uoga huno ukaihwa hivyo kpwa sababu kofiyaye ina uhereza.
